name_th: คิดถึงวันเก่า
meaning: A warm-sad pull toward a remembered past that cannot return; the memory itself is pleasant, the distance is not. Typical when an old object, place or song brings a period of life back.
speaker_intent: To share or relive a memory, often inviting the listener into it rather than asking for anything.
pitch_level: slightly lower than baseline, lifting a little on the remembered detail
pitch_range: moderate-narrow; gentle rises on the loved images, soft falls at phrase ends
rate: slow-moderate; the memory words are lingered over
energy: low-medium, soft onsets, no hard attacks
pauses: a short pause before the memory starts ('สมัยก่อน...') and a longer trailing pause after it, as if still looking at it
voice_quality: slightly breathy and warm; a smile can be heard on the fond detail
breath: soft inhale before the recollection, a gentle exhale or tiny laugh-breath after it
emphasis: the sensory detail (the smell, the shop sign, the name) gets length rather than loudness
thai_note: Carry the warmth with slower rate, softer voice and lengthened vowels on nouns of the memory; let particles like นะ, เนอะ, จ้ะ end phrases softly. Do not bend lexical tones to sound wistful: the tone of each syllable stays, only overall pitch level, range and breathiness move.
examples_th: สมัยก่อนนะหลาน ร้านนี้ยังเป็นตู้ไม้อยู่เลย ยายจำกลิ่นมันได้จนทุกวันนี้จ้ะ
แว่นอันแรกของพี่ก็กรอบกลมๆ แบบนี้แหละครับ ใส่ไปโรงเรียนทุกวันเลย
examples_en: My first pair looked just like this... I wore them every single day.
variants: Fond and smiling: brighter on the detail, small laugh-breath at the end.
Distant: flatter, slower, eyes on something far away, last word fades.
Storytelling to a child: warmer, a little more melody, inviting pauses.
Catching yourself: memory flows, then a brief stop and a quiet return to the present.
ai_mistakes: Plays it as plain sadness: heavy, crying, no warmth.
Over-bright 'happy memory' tone with no sense of loss.
Even pacing that never lingers on the remembered detail.
Adds sobbing breaths that the text does not support.
gemini_style: someone fondly remembering the old days, warm and a little wistful, slow with a soft smile
evidence_note: No direct acoustic study of nostalgia; placement borrows low-arousal tendencies (tenderness/sadness) from JuslinLaukka2003. Performance notes are craft.

name_th: โหยหา
meaning: Aching desire for a person, place or time that is absent; more pain and pull than nostalgia, and directed at something still wanted.
speaker_intent: To voice a want that cannot be met right now, sometimes half-hoping the absent one hears.
pitch_level: slightly lower, with occasional lifts on the wanted thing
pitch_range: moderate; phrase ends may stay suspended rather than fully falling
energy: low-medium, swelling slightly on the name or object of longing
pauses: pauses after the name of the missed person; phrases can trail off unfinished
voice_quality: breathy, occasionally thin; a slight catch possible on the name
breath: longer inhales, a sigh-like exhale before or after the line
emphasis: the absent person or place is lengthened and slightly louder, then the voice drops
thai_note: Express the ache with suspended phrase ends, breathy quality and lengthened vowels, especially on the name. Soft particles เนอะ / นะ / จัง (คิดถึงจัง) help. Lexical tones of names and words stay intact; the longing lives in level, range, length and breath.
examples_th: คิดถึงตาจังเลยนะ... ถ้าตายังอยู่ คงได้มาเห็นร้านนี้ด้วยกันแล้ว
อยากกลับไปเห็นทะเลตอนเช้าแบบนั้นอีกสักครั้งจังครับ
examples_en: I just want to see her face clearly one more time.
variants: Quiet ache: almost whispered, name stretched.
Reaching: a slight rise of energy on the wish, then giving up.
Composed longing: steady voice, only the last word thins out.
Talking to the absent one: intimate, as if they are just out of reach.
ai_mistakes: Turns longing into theatrical grief with sobs.
Falls hard and final at every phrase end, killing the unresolved feel.
Rushes the name instead of holding it.
Uses a dreamy upbeat lilt that reads as romance ad.
gemini_style: someone aching for a person they miss, soft and breathy, slow, phrases left hanging
evidence_note: Longing is not a category in the main acted-speech studies; breathy/soft tendencies borrowed from sadness and tenderness findings. Mostly craft.

name_th: เปราะบาง เปิดใจ
meaning: Letting guard down and exposing something fragile (a fear, a need, a shame) with the risk of being hurt.
speaker_intent: To be honest about something hard and implicitly ask to be met gently.
pitch_level: slightly higher or lower than baseline depending on character, but less projected
rate: slow and uneven; speeds up past the hardest word
energy: low, quiet, close to the mic
pauses: hesitation before the admission, sometimes mid-phrase; a pause after it waiting for reaction
voice_quality: soft, breathy, can go thin or slightly shaky
breath: audible inhale to gather courage before the key line
emphasis: little emphasis; the admitted thing is said more quietly, not louder
thai_note: Use quietness, hesitation and softer particles (นะ, อ่ะ, คือ... as a starter) rather than pitch tricks. Hedges like คือว่า / ไม่รู้สิ show exposure. Keep lexical tones correct even when the voice is small.
examples_th: คือ... ผมกลัวครับ กลัวว่าตาจะมองไม่เห็นเหมือนพ่อ
หนูไม่เคยบอกใครเลยนะคะ ว่าหนูอายที่ต้องใส่แว่นหนาขนาดนี้
examples_en: I... I'm scared I'll lose my sight like my dad did.
variants: Small and steady: quiet but controlled, one wobble.
Blurted: hesitation, then the confession comes out in a rush.
Half-laugh to cover it: tiny nervous laugh before the truth.
Whispered to a trusted person: intimate, very close.
ai_mistakes: Delivers the confession at normal projection, sounding like a statement of fact.
Removes all hesitation so it sounds rehearsed.
Raises pitch like a child regardless of character age.
gemini_style: someone admitting a fear for the first time, quiet and hesitant, a little shaky
evidence_note: No direct acoustic study; low-dominance placement from PAD framing, soft/breathy quality from voice-quality work. Performance is craft.

name_th: เข้าใจความรู้สึก
meaning: Feeling with another person and showing you understand their situation from inside it.
speaker_intent: To make the other person feel understood rather than fixed.
pitch_level: baseline or slightly lower, matching the other's energy
pauses: a listening pause before speaking; brief pause after naming their feeling
breath: relaxed, an audible soft breath in before responding
emphasis: on the word that names their feeling or situation ('ยาก', 'เหนื่อย')
thai_note: Warmth comes from slower rate, softer onset and particles like นะ / เนอะ / เลย (เข้าใจเลย). Mirroring words (ใช่ เหนื่อยเนอะ) matter more than pitch. Lexical tones stay; empathy changes level, softness and pacing only.
examples_th: ใช่ครับ ต้องเปลี่ยนเลนส์บ่อยๆ แบบนี้ เหนื่อยเนอะ ผมเข้าใจเลย
ไม่ต้องรีบนะคะ ค่อยๆ เล่าก็ได้ ฟังอยู่ค่ะ
examples_en: Yeah, that sounds really tiring. I get it.
variants: Mirroring: match their low energy, then lift slightly.
Quiet nodding voice: short phrases, lots of space.
Shared experience: a little personal warmth, 'me too'.
Professional empathy: calm, steady, still personal.
ai_mistakes: Pity tone talking down to the listener.
Over-emphasizes every word as if acting caring.
gemini_style: a warm friend who truly understands, gentle and unhurried, no sales tone
evidence_note: Empathy as vocal style is not a category in the acted-emotion corpora; notes are craft plus general warmth/low-arousal tendencies.

name_th: ปลอบโยน
meaning: Actively comforting someone who is hurting, offering safety and presence.
speaker_intent: To soothe, calm and hold the other person emotionally.
pitch_range: narrow to moderate, smooth rocking contours
pauses: regular soft pauses, giving the listener time to breathe
breath: slow audible breaths that model calm breathing
emphasis: minimal; gentle weight on reassurance words ('ไม่เป็นไร', 'อยู่ตรงนี้')
thai_note: Use จ้ะ / นะ / นะลูก / นะหลาน and lengthened soft endings; repetition (ไม่เป็นไรนะ ไม่เป็นไร) soothes. Lower overall pitch and slow rate; never alter tones of words like ไม่ to sound softer.
examples_th: ไม่เป็นไรนะหลาน ร้องออกมาเถอะ ยายอยู่ตรงนี้จ้ะ
ค่อยๆ หายใจนะครับ ไม่ต้องกลัว ตาคุณยังดีอยู่ เดี๋ยวเราดูกันไปทีละขั้น
examples_en: Shh, it's okay. I'm right here.
variants: Grandmotherly: very soft, rocking rhythm, จ้ะ endings.
Steady adult: calm, firm warmth, clear words.
Whispered: almost no voice, very close.
Gentle humor to lift: soft smile in the voice after comfort.
ai_mistakes: Sounds sad itself instead of steady, so it does not comfort.
Bright cheerful tone that dismisses the pain.
gemini_style: a gentle grandmother comforting a crying child, very soft, slow and steady
evidence_note: Tenderness in acted-speech reviews tends toward slow rate, low intensity and soft voice; consoling as a speech act is craft.

name_th: เห็นใจ
meaning: Feeling sorry for someone's misfortune from a little outside it; less immersed than empathy.
speaker_intent: To acknowledge another's bad luck and show you care, often briefly.
pauses: short pause before the sympathetic phrase ('โถ...')
breath: a small sigh before 'โถ' or 'แย่จัง'
emphasis: on the misfortune word, softened
thai_note: Interjections โถ / โธ่ / แย่จัง carry sympathy; lengthen them softly. Particles นะ / เนอะ / จัง. Keep the lexical tone of โถ and others; sympathy comes from breathy onset and slower falls in overall phrase pitch.
examples_th: โถ... แว่นหักวันแรกเลยเหรอคะ แย่จังเลย
โธ่ ลุงชาญ ทำแว่นตกน้ำอีกแล้วเหรอครับ น่าสงสารจริงๆ
examples_en: Oh no, on the very first day? That's awful.
variants: Brief and kind: one soft sigh-word, then move on.
Polite shop register: sympathy plus offer of help.
Light sympathy with a small smile for a minor mishap.
ai_mistakes: Overacted grief for a small problem.
Flat reading of 'โถ' as a normal word.
gemini_style: kindly sorry for someone's bad luck, soft and sincere, a little sigh
evidence_note: No acoustic study of sympathy as such; craft notes only.

name_th: ประชด
meaning: Saying something positive while meaning the negative, usually to criticize or show annoyance.
speaker_intent: To criticize indirectly and make the target feel the gap between words and reality.
pitch_level: often lower than baseline (English data); or exaggeratedly high as an alternative style
pitch_range: either flattened (deadpan) or exaggerated sing-song; both signal non-literal meaning
pauses: a beat before the praise word, sometimes a beat after for it to land
voice_quality: slightly pressed or nasal-drawled; no genuine smile warmth
breath: a short exhale through the nose before or after (a 'huff')
emphasis: praise words are lengthened and stressed beyond normal ('เก่ง~มาก')
thai_note: Thai sarcasm (ประชด) leans on lengthening the praise word, a too-flat or over-sung overall contour, and particle choice: นะ / เนอะ / จริงๆ / เลย, or the pointed ซะ / ซะด้วย, ดีจริงนะ. Context (praise after a mistake) is the main cue. Never distort the lexical tone of เก่ง or ดี; sarcasm shifts level, range, rate and length. CheangPell2008 measured English only; Thai cues are unverified craft.
examples_th: เก่งมากเลยนะต้น ใส่เลนส์กลับข้างอีกแล้ว
ดีจริงๆ เลยค่ะ นัดสิบโมง มาบ่ายสาม ร้านปิดพอดีเลย
examples_en: Oh, great job. Lenses in backwards. Again.
variants: Deadpan: flat, slow, low; praise said like a weather report.
Exaggerated sing-song: over-bright melody, stretched vowels, obvious fake cheer.
Tired sarcasm: sighed praise, low energy.
Sharp sarcasm: crisp, clipped praise with a pointed pause after.
ai_mistakes: Reads the praise literally, cheerful and sincere.
Adds anger so it becomes a scolding, not sarcasm.
No lengthening on the key praise word.
In Thai, changes the lexical tone of เก่ง/ดี to sound ironic, making the word wrong.
gemini_style: dripping with sarcasm, slow and flat, stretching the praise word so it clearly means the opposite
evidence_note: CheangPell2008 found English sarcasm tends toward slower rate, lower mean F0 and less F0 variation (acted, English). No Thai data; Thai particle/lengthening cues are craft.

name_th: แซวแบบหน้าตาย
meaning: Understated remark whose meaning differs from the literal words, delivered without visible emotion; milder and more amused than sarcasm.
speaker_intent: To comment wryly on a situation, inviting the listener to catch the joke.
pauses: a deadpan beat before the punch word or after the line
voice_quality: neutral, relaxed; maybe a hint of amusement at the very end
breath: nothing special; calmness is the point
emphasis: almost none; understatement itself is the cue
thai_note: In Thai, dry irony works through understatement words (นิดหน่อย, ก็...ดี) said flat with a neutral particle (ครับ / ค่ะ / นะ). Avoid sing-song. Tones stay lexical; only the contour is flattened and rate evened. Example positive-but-negative: 'ก็สวยดีนะ' about a broken frame. CheangPell2008 is English-only.
examples_th: ก็... ใส่ได้อยู่นะครับ ถ้าไม่ซีเรียสว่าเลนส์มันร้าวครึ่งนึง
ฝนตกทั้งวันแบบนี้ ลูกค้าคงแน่นร้านเลยค่ะ
examples_en: Well, it's technically still a pair of glasses.
variants: Wry: flat until a tiny smile breath at the end.
Mock-earnest: overly serious delivery of a silly point.
ai_mistakes: Plays it as a joke with a bright laugh, losing dryness.
Reads it sincerely, so the irony disappears.
gemini_style: bone-dry, deadpan and understated, like a wry comedian who never smiles
evidence_note: CheangPell2008 studied sarcasm, not dry irony, in English; flat-contour notes are an extension. No Thai data.

name_th: แซวเล่น
meaning: Affectionate poking fun that signals closeness; the target is meant to laugh too.
speaker_intent: To bond and lighten the mood by gently embarrassing someone.
pauses: a cheeky beat before the punch
voice_quality: smiling voice, light laughter in the breath
breath: small laugh-breaths, a giggle at the end
emphasis: on the teased detail, stretched playfully
thai_note: Teasing in Thai uses particles like น้า / นะจ๊ะ / อ่ะดิ / เนอะ, lengthened ending vowels and a smiling voice. Can use positive-but-mocking words (หล่อจังเลยน้า) with a wide sing-song range. Lexical tones must stay; the play is in range, length and laugh-breath.
examples_th: โห ใส่แว่นใหม่แล้วหล่อขึ้นเยอะเลยน้า ต้น มีแฟนแล้วหรือยังจ๊ะ
มิ้นท์ใส่แว่นกลับหัวอีกแล้วอ่ะ ตั้งใจใช่มั้ยเนี่ย
examples_en: Ooh, new glasses! Someone's trying to impress somebody.
variants: Sing-song: big melodic stretch on the teased word.
Fake-serious: stern voice that cracks into laughter.
Grandma tease: slow, knowing, warm chuckle.
ai_mistakes: Sounds mean or mocking instead of affectionate.
No laugh or smile in the voice.
Same melody on every word, losing the punch.
gemini_style: affectionately teasing a friend, playful sing-song with a giggle
evidence_note: Teasing has no direct acoustic study in the listed sources; smiling-voice notes are craft.

name_th: เยาะเย้ย ล้อเลียน
meaning: Ridiculing someone to belittle them, sometimes by imitating their voice or words.
speaker_intent: To humiliate or assert superiority.
pitch_level: varies; imitations go exaggeratedly high or nasal
rate: uneven: drawn-out mimicry, then quick jab
pauses: a pause for laughter or reaction after the jab
voice_quality: nasal, whiny or exaggerated when imitating; harsh laugh
emphasis: on the target's own words, parroted
thai_note: Thai mockery often repeats the target's words with exaggerated length and a whiny or nasal quality, plus ขำ laugh (ฮ่าๆ) and particles like อ่ะ / ว่ะ / จ้า (dragged). Imitation must still keep correct lexical tones of the words; caricature lives in voice quality and range.
examples_th: 'ผมมองเห็นชัดดีครับ' แหม ชัดมากเลยจ้า ชนเสาไปสองต้นแล้ว
ฮ่าๆ แว่นก้นขวดแบบนั้นยังกล้าใส่ออกมาอีกเหรอวะ
examples_en: 'I can see just fine.' Sure you can. That's why you walked into the door.
variants: Parrot mimicry: whiny imitation of the victim.
Crowd-playing: loud, laughing, looking for agreement.
Fake pity: 'aww' tone that is clearly contemptuous.
ai_mistakes: Imitation is not distinguishable from the narrator voice.
Too angry; mockery is amused superiority.
Laughs that sound happy rather than scornful.
gemini_style: a smug bully mocking someone, exaggerated whiny imitation then a scornful laugh
evidence_note: High-dominance placement from PAD framing; no acoustic study of mockery in the listed sources. Craft.

name_th: ไม่ค่อยเชื่อ
meaning: Doubting a claim and wanting proof before accepting it.
speaker_intent: To question, signal doubt and push for evidence without open hostility.
pitch_range: moderate, with a rise-fall or drawn questioning contour on the doubted word
pauses: a beat before repeating the claim back
voice_quality: slightly pressed, a little nasal drawl
emphasis: on the claim being doubted, stretched ('จริง~เหรอ')
thai_note: Thai skepticism uses question particles เหรอ / หรอ / จริงดิ / แน่ใจนะ, often lengthened, plus 'อืม...' openers. Stretch the doubted word in length; do not change its tone. A flat drawn เหรอ reads as doubt; a high bright one reads as surprise.
examples_th: แว่นราคาสองร้อย กันแสงสีฟ้าได้หมดเลยเหรอครับ... จริงเหรอ
อืม... ลุงบอกว่าไม่ได้ทำตกใช่มั้ย แล้วทำไมขามันงอล่ะ
examples_en: Blocks a hundred percent of blue light? For that price? Really.
variants: Raised-eyebrow: drawn-out flat เหรอ.
ai_mistakes: Plays surprise instead of doubt (bright high rise).
Reads question as a neutral information question.
gemini_style: skeptical and unconvinced, slow, raising a doubtful eyebrow
evidence_note: Intonation contours carry attitudes (BanzigerScherer2005 discusses this generally); skepticism-specific cues are craft.

name_th: ระแวง สงสัย
meaning: Believing someone may be hiding something or intending harm; doubt mixed with wariness.
speaker_intent: To probe and watch for a lie while staying guarded.
pauses: long watchful pauses, especially after a question
voice_quality: slightly tense, quieter, can drop toward a murmur
breath: held breath; slow exhale after the question
emphasis: on who / what / why words, pressed
thai_note: Use slow rate, lower level and probing particles (ใช่มั้ย / แน่นะ / ล่ะ / เหรอ said low and flat). Pauses do more than pitch. Lexical tones unchanged.
examples_th: เมื่อคืนใครเข้ามาในร้านครับ... ประตูมันล็อกอยู่นะ
ยายจันทร์... ยายอยู่ตรงนั้นใช่มั้ย ผมได้ยินเสียงเลื่อนตู้นะ
examples_en: Who was in the shop last night? The door was locked.
variants: Quiet watchful: low and slow, long silences.
Nervous suspicion: wary, slightly faster, glancing.
Friendly surface, suspicious underneath: polite but probing.
ai_mistakes: Pitch rises as if simply asking.
gemini_style: quietly suspicious, slow and guarded, watching for a lie
evidence_note: No direct acoustic study; craft.

name_th: ตั้งการ์ด แก้ตัว
meaning: Protecting oneself against perceived blame or criticism, often by justifying or counter-attacking.
speaker_intent: To deflect blame and protect self-image.
pitch_range: wider, jumpy, rising at the end of justifications
pauses: few pauses; overlapping 'but' starts
breath: quick inhale before 'ไม่ใช่นะ'
emphasis: on denial words (ไม่ได้, ก็, แต่) and on 'I'
thai_note: Defensive Thai stacks justifiers ก็... / แต่... / ไม่ได้... and particles นะ / อ่ะ / ดิ / เว้ย said quickly with higher level. Keep tones of ไม่ / ได้ correct; the defense is in rate, level and tension, not in warped tones.
examples_th: ไม่ได้ทำตกนะครับ! มันหลุดเอง ก็วางไว้บนโต๊ะดีๆ แล้วอ่ะ
ก็หนูบอกแล้วไงคะว่าไม่ได้ลืม แค่... ยังไม่ได้ทำเฉยๆ
examples_en: I didn't drop them! They just... fell. It's not my fault.
variants: Cold defense: clipped, formal, walls up.
Laughing it off: nervous laugh, minimizing.
ai_mistakes: Calm and reasonable, losing the edge.
Pure anger without the self-protective whine.
Over-high childish pitch for an adult.
gemini_style: defensive and flustered, quick, protesting that it's not their fault
evidence_note: Arousal-related tendencies (faster, higher) from general reviews; defensiveness itself is not studied. Craft.

name_th: ขุ่นเคือง ไม่ยอม
meaning: Anger at something perceived as unfair or morally wrong; righteous rather than personal.
speaker_intent: To protest an injustice and demand it be acknowledged.
pitch_range: wide, with strong falls on the unfair fact
rate: moderate-fast, but deliberate on the key complaint
pauses: a sharp pause before stating what is unfair
emphasis: heavy stress on the injustice (ไม่ยุติธรรม, ได้ยังไง)
thai_note: Use rhetorical frames ได้ยังไง / มันใช่เหรอ / ไม่ถูกนะ with strong overall falls and louder voice; particles ครับ / ค่ะ can stay and even sharpen politeness-in-anger. Tones of words stay lexical; indignation raises level, range and intensity.
examples_th: ขายแว่นปลอมให้คนแก่แบบนี้ได้ยังไงครับ มันไม่ถูกนะ!
เขาเก็บเงินค่าตรวจตาไปแล้ว แต่ไม่ได้ตรวจเลยค่ะ ทำแบบนี้ได้ยังไง
examples_en: They sold fake lenses to an old man? How is that okay?
variants: Controlled moral outrage: firm, slower, each word set down.
Shocked indignation: opens with disbelief, then rises.
Polite but outraged: formal words, sharp delivery.
ai_mistakes: Pure rage with no moral clarity.
gemini_style: righteously indignant at an injustice, firm and rising, strong emphasis on what's unfair
evidence_note: Hot anger tendencies (higher F0, more intensity, faster) are well supported in acted speech; indignation as a sub-type is not separately measured.

name_th: เจ็บเพราะถูกหักหลัง
meaning: Pain at being let down by someone trusted; shock and grief with anger underneath.
speaker_intent: To make the betrayer understand the damage, or to process disbelief.
pitch_level: variable: drops low in disbelief, can crack higher on the accusation
rate: slow on the realization, quicker on the accusation
pauses: a stunned pause before speaking; pause after 'ทำไม'
emphasis: on 'you' and on the trust word (เชื่อ, ไว้ใจ)
thai_note: Thai betrayal lines often hinge on เชื่อ / ไว้ใจ / ทำไม with a stunned pause; particles can drop out entirely (rawness) or be pointed (เหรอ). Let the voice break rather than bend tones; lexical tones remain.
examples_th: ผมไว้ใจพี่นะ... แล้วพี่ก็เอาสูตรเลนส์ของร้านไปขายเขาเหรอ
ทำไมไม่บอกหนูตั้งแต่แรกคะ หนูเชื่อแม่มาตลอดเลยนะ
examples_en: I trusted you. And you just... sold us out?
variants: Breaking accusation: starts low, cracks up on 'why'.
Cold betrayal: hurt hidden behind flat calm.
ai_mistakes: Smooth, stable voice with no breaks.
gemini_style: deeply hurt by someone they trusted, stunned and shaky, voice nearly breaking
evidence_note: Combination of sadness and anger tendencies; no direct study of betrayal. Craft.

name_th: ขมขื่น
meaning: Lasting resentment over past unfairness; anger that has gone cold and sour.
speaker_intent: To vent resentment, often cynically, without expecting change.
pitch_range: narrow, flat with occasional sharp dips
pauses: pauses before the cynical point
voice_quality: slightly creaky or pressed, sour; a mirthless laugh possible
emphasis: on the old grievance, said with a sneer
thai_note: Thai bitterness uses phrases like ก็งั้นแหละ / มันก็เป็นแบบนี้ / ใช่สิ said low and flat, often with a dry scoff. Particles may be dropped or clipped (แหละ, ล่ะ). Tones intact; sourness is in creak, low level and narrow range.
examples_th: ใช่สิ ร้านใหญ่เขาก็ได้ลูกค้าไปหมดแหละ ร้านเล็กๆ อย่างเราก็รอไปเถอะ
ตาข้างนี้มันเสียเพราะหมอคนนั้นแหละ... ป่านนี้เขาคงลืมไปแล้วมั้ง
examples_en: Sure. The big chains always win. Why would anyone care about us?
variants: Sour mutter: low, half to self.
Cynical laugh: dry laugh before the line.
Old wound: tired and quiet, one sharp word.
ai_mistakes: Missing the dry scoff/laugh where natural.
gemini_style: bitter and resentful, low and flat, with a dry humorless scoff
evidence_note: Cold/low-arousal anger tendencies are a reasonable analogy; bitterness itself is unmeasured. Craft.

name_th: ยอมแพ้ ปลง
meaning: Giving up hope of changing something; accepting defeat with sadness, not peace.
speaker_intent: To stop fighting and state the unchangeable, often wearily.
pauses: a sigh-pause before the line; flat ends
voice_quality: lax, breathy or creaky at ends
emphasis: almost none; words weigh the same
thai_note: Use ก็... / ช่างมันเถอะ / จะทำไงได้ล่ะ with a sigh and low flat phrase; particles ล่ะ / แหละ / นะ soft and dropped. Lexical tones keep their shape even in a flat, low register.
examples_th: ช่างมันเถอะครับ... ร้านก็คงต้องปิดสิ้นเดือนนี้แหละ
จะทำไงได้ล่ะลูก ตาของยายมันก็แก่ไปตามวัย
examples_en: Whatever. It's not going to change anyway.
variants: Bitter-edged resignation: flat with a slight sneer.
ai_mistakes: Calm acceptance tone that sounds at peace.
gemini_style: resigned and defeated, a long sigh, slow and flat, no fight left
evidence_note: Low-arousal sadness tendencies (lower F0, narrow range, slow, soft) are well supported in acted speech; resignation as such is not separated.

name_th: ยอมรับได้ สงบ
meaning: Peaceful acknowledgment of a reality, including a loss, without fighting it.
speaker_intent: To make peace and move forward, often reassuring others too.
pauses: comfortable pauses; no tension in silences
breath: a calm exhale, almost a soft smile
emphasis: gentle weight on the acceptance word (ไม่เป็นไร, ดีแล้ว)
thai_note: Thai acceptance often sounds like ไม่เป็นไร / ดีแล้วล่ะ / ก็ดีนะ with a relaxed downward phrase and soft particles (จ้ะ, นะ). Difference from resignation is warmth and steadiness, not tones. Lexical tones intact.
examples_th: ไม่เป็นไรหรอกหลาน ยายอยู่มานานพอแล้ว ได้เห็นร้านนี้ไปต่อ ยายก็ดีใจจ้ะ
ตาข้างนี้คงไม่กลับมาชัดเหมือนเดิมแล้ว ก็ไม่เป็นไรครับ ยังมีอีกข้าง
examples_en: It's alright. I've made my peace with it.
variants: Hard-won peace: a slight catch, then settled.
Wise elder: slow, warm, gentle authority.
gemini_style: peacefully accepting a loss, calm, warm and steady
evidence_note: Low-arousal positive placement from the circumplex; no acoustic study of acceptance. Craft.

name_th: ลังเล
meaning: Uncertainty about what to say or do; the speaker is deciding while speaking.
speaker_intent: To buy time, avoid committing, or soften what comes next.
pitch_level: baseline, sometimes slightly higher on fillers
pitch_range: narrow, with level or slightly rising holds on fillers
rate: slow and broken; fluent bursts between stops
pauses: filled pauses (เอ่อ, อืม, คือ) and unfilled gaps mid-phrase, false starts
voice_quality: slightly lax, creak on held fillers
emphasis: little; the word finally chosen may land a bit harder
thai_note: Thai hesitation markers: เอ่อ / อืม / คือ / ก็... / แบบว่า, elongated and held level. Do not invent tones on fillers; keep them natural. Particles often come late (...ครับ) after a gap.
examples_th: เอ่อ... คือ... ผมว่า เลนส์คู่นี้อาจจะ... ไม่ค่อยเหมาะกับลุงนะครับ
จะเลือกกรอบดำหรือ... อืม... กรอบทองดีคะ
examples_en: Um... I think... maybe these aren't quite right for you?
variants: Thinking aloud: calm, long อืม.
Indecisive shopper: back-and-forth with light laugh.
ai_mistakes: Reads fillers as clean words with full stress.
Inserts fillers in every phrase until it sounds broken.
Pauses at grammatically wrong places only.
gemini_style: hesitant and unsure, pausing with ums, choosing words carefully
evidence_note: Disfluency is studied in psycholinguistics but not in the listed sources; craft notes.

name_th: ประหม่า ตื่นเต้น
meaning: Mild anxious arousal before or during something uncertain (a test, a first meeting, a presentation).
speaker_intent: To get through the moment while managing jittery feelings.
rate: faster, with rushed phrases and stumbles
pauses: short irregular pauses, swallows, restarts
breath: shallow quick breaths, audible inhale before speaking
emphasis: uneven; sometimes too much on minor words
thai_note: Nervousness raises overall pitch and rate; particles may be over-used (ครับ ครับ / ค่ะ) as politeness reflex. Stumbles on words are fine but lexical tones must stay correct.
examples_th: สะ สวัสดีครับ วันนี้ผมจะ... จะตรวจสายตาให้นะครับ ไม่ต้องเกร็งนะครับ
หนูไม่เคยใส่คอนแทคเลนส์เลยค่ะ มันจะเจ็บมั้ยคะ
examples_en: H-hi! I'll be, um, doing your eye test today.
variants: Tight and quiet, holding it in.
ai_mistakes: Full panic instead of mild nerves.
Stutters inserted unnaturally or in Thai mid-syllable.
gemini_style: a nervous young man on his first day, slightly fast and shaky, trying to sound confident
evidence_note: Anxiety/fear in acted speech tends toward higher F0 and faster rate; nervousness as a mild form is extrapolated.

name_th: หงุดหงิด รอไม่ไหว
meaning: Irritation at delay or slowness; wanting things to move now.
speaker_intent: To speed someone up or signal annoyance at waiting.
pauses: short; maybe one exasperated pause
emphasis: on time words (ยัง, นาน, เร็วๆ)
thai_note: Thai impatience uses ยังอีกเหรอ / เร็วๆ หน่อย / สักที with clipped particles (ดิ, เหอะ, ซะที) and tsk sounds (จิ๊). Faster rate and sharper attacks, not altered tones.
examples_th: ยังไม่เสร็จอีกเหรอครับ รอมาชั่วโมงนึงแล้วนะ
เร็วๆ หน่อยดิต้น ลูกค้ารออยู่หน้าร้านแล้ว
examples_en: Is it done yet? I've been waiting an hour.
gemini_style: impatient and irritated by waiting, quick and clipped, with an annoyed sigh
evidence_note: Mild-anger arousal tendencies; impatience not separately studied.

name_th: เร่งด่วน
meaning: Pressing need to act immediately because of time or danger.
speaker_intent: To get someone to act now.
rate: fast, but key instructions slightly slower for clarity
pauses: minimal; short breaths between commands
emphasis: on action verbs and time words (เดี๋ยวนี้, ตอนนี้, เร็ว)
thai_note: Use imperatives with เร็ว / เดี๋ยวนี้ / ด่วน, particles ดิ / เลย / ครับ short and clipped. Raise level and pace; keep tones of command words exact so the meaning is clear.
examples_th: ต้น! ปิดไฟร้านเดี๋ยวนี้เลย ไฟช็อตแล้ว
พาคุณยายไปโรงพยาบาลด่วนเลยค่ะ ตาแดงแบบนี้ไม่ได้รอนะคะ
examples_en: Get her to the hospital now. This can't wait.
gemini_style: urgent and pressing, fast and loud, telling someone to act right now
evidence_note: High-arousal tendencies generalize; urgency is not an emotion category in the studies. Craft.

name_th: สั่งการ มีอำนาจ
meaning: Speaking with full control and expectation of obedience.
speaker_intent: To direct action and establish who is in charge.
pauses: clean pauses between commands; silence used for weight
emphasis: on the verb and the person addressed
thai_note: Authority in Thai often drops softening particles or uses a firm ครับ / ค่ะ at the end with falling phrase pitch; imperative frames (ให้ / ต้อง / ห้าม). Lexical tones stay; authority is in low level, firm falls and steady rate.
examples_th: ทุกคนฟังผมนะ ห้ามใครแตะตู้เลนส์จนกว่าผมจะเช็กเสร็จ
วางแว่นลงค่ะ แล้วนั่งตรงนี้
examples_en: Everyone, listen. Nobody touches that cabinet.
variants: Quiet authority: low and calm, no volume needed.
Stern elder: slow, heavy, disappointed authority.
ai_mistakes: Rising question intonation at the end.
gemini_style: a calm, commanding leader, low and firm, expecting to be obeyed
evidence_note: Dominance dimension from PAD; authoritative voice cues are craft.

name_th: อ้อนวอน
meaning: Begging someone for help, mercy or a change of mind, from a powerless position.
speaker_intent: To persuade by showing need and helplessness.
pitch_range: wide, with rising and wavering contours
rate: variable: fast rush then drawn-out key word
pauses: brief, breathy; pause before 'please'
emphasis: on 'please' and the need
thai_note: Thai pleading: นะ นะ / ขอร้อง / ได้โปรด / เถอะนะ, lengthened particle (นะ~), voice rising and cracking. Do not distort the lexical tone of ขอร้อง; pleading changes range and breathiness.
examples_th: ขอร้องล่ะครับ อย่าเพิ่งปิดร้านเลย ให้ผมลองอีกเดือนนะ นะครับ
ยายอย่าไปนะ... หนูขอร้อง อยู่กับหนูก่อนเถอะ
examples_en: Please, just one more month. Please.
gemini_style: desperately pleading, voice rising and cracking, begging them to change their mind
evidence_note: Low dominance placement; pleading cues are craft.

name_th: ทำให้มั่นใจ
meaning: Telling someone things will be fine, from a position of calm competence.
speaker_intent: To reduce the listener's worry and build trust.
pauses: short, confident pauses after key facts
emphasis: on the safety word (ปลอดภัย, ไม่เจ็บ, ไม่เป็นไร)
thai_note: Use ไม่ต้องห่วง / ไม่เป็นไร / เดี๋ยว...ให้ with steady particles ครับ / ค่ะ / นะ. Confident falling phrases; avoid rising question tails. Tones lexical.
examples_th: ไม่ต้องห่วงนะครับ ตรวจตาไม่เจ็บเลย แค่มองตัวหนังสือเฉยๆ
แว่นจะเสร็จพรุ่งนี้เช้าแน่นอนค่ะ เดี๋ยวโทรบอกนะคะ
examples_en: Don't worry, it doesn't hurt at all.
variants: Soft and gentle for a scared child.
gemini_style: calm and reassuring, warm and confident, like a kind doctor
evidence_note: Craft only.

name_th: ให้กำลังใจ
meaning: Supporting someone to try or keep going.
speaker_intent: To raise the listener's confidence and motivation.
pauses: a beat before the 'you can' line
emphasis: on the person's ability (ได้, เก่ง, ไหว)
thai_note: Thai encouragement: สู้ๆ / ทำได้ / ไหวอยู่แล้ว / เก่งมาก with sincere bright voice and particles นะ / เลย / อยู่แล้ว. Sincere เก่งมาก has brighter voice quality and genuine warmth, versus sarcasm's flat or over-stretched contour. Tones stay lexical.
examples_th: อ่านได้ถึงแถวที่ห้าแล้ว เก่งมากเลยครับ อีกนิดเดียวนะ
สู้ๆ นะมิ้นท์ ใส่แว่นใหม่แล้วต้องสอบผ่านแน่นอน
examples_en: You're doing great, just one more line!
gemini_style: warmly encouraging, bright and sincere, cheering someone on
evidence_note: Positive higher-arousal tendencies; encouragement not studied. Craft.

name_th: ข่มขู่เงียบๆ
meaning: Threatening without raising the voice; danger conveyed through control (the speaker induces fear rather than feeling it).
speaker_intent: To intimidate by calm certainty.
pauses: long, loaded pauses before the threat
voice_quality: breathy-low or slightly creaky, very controlled
emphasis: subtle; key word said even softer
thai_note: Thai menace: quiet, low, slow with neutral or overly polite particles (นะครับ said slowly) which add chill. Lexical tones kept; the threat is in low level, narrow range and pacing.
examples_th: คืนนี้... อย่าเปิดประตูหลังร้านนะครับ ถ้ายังอยากเห็นพรุ่งนี้
ฉันรู้นะ ว่าแกเอาแว่นของยายไป... เอามาคืนซะ
examples_en: Don't open the back door tonight. If you want to see tomorrow.
variants: Smiling menace: pleasant tone with dark words.
gemini_style: quietly menacing, low and slow, calm and dangerous
evidence_note: High dominance + low arousal placement; cues are craft.

name_th: เกรงใจ
meaning: Thai เกรงใจ: reluctance to impose on, inconvenience or embarrass others, especially seniors or customers; shows respect and care for their feelings.
speaker_intent: To ask, offer or speak without making the other person feel burdened or pressured.
pitch_level: slightly higher or softer than baseline
pauses: a small hesitation before the request; softened endings
emphasis: on softeners rather than the request
thai_note: Pragmatics: เกรงใจ is valued politeness, not weakness. Signals: softening particles นะคะ / นะครับ / หน่อย / ได้มั้ยคะ, hedges อาจจะ / คงจะ / ถ้าไม่รบกวน / ถ้าสะดวก, and ไม่เป็นไร to release the other. Respect terms (คุณ, พี่, คุณป้า). Softness comes from level, rate and quality; lexical tones never change. Relates to negative politeness (BrownLevinson1987).
examples_th: ขอโทษนะครับคุณป้า ถ้าไม่รบกวน ขอให้ช่วยถอดแว่นสักครู่ได้มั้ยครับ
ไม่เป็นไรค่ะพี่ ถ้าพี่ไม่สะดวก หนูมารับพรุ่งนี้ก็ได้นะคะ
examples_en: Sorry to bother you, but if it's not too much trouble, could you take your glasses off for a moment?
variants: Junior to senior: very soft, many particles.
Shop staff to customer: polite smiling service.
Guest refusing offered food: warm, apologetic.
Embarrassed asking a favor: hesitant laugh.
ai_mistakes: Reads polite words with direct, assertive tone.
Drops or rushes particles นะคะ/นะครับ.
Translates the English idea and loses Thai hedges.
gemini_style: a polite young Thai person gently asking a favor of an elder, soft and considerate, not wanting to impose
evidence_note: Politeness theory explains the strategy; no acoustic study of krengjai speech in listed sources. Thai cues are cultural/craft knowledge.

name_th: ปฏิเสธแบบเกรงใจ
meaning: Saying no indirectly to avoid hurting or embarrassing the other person; the refusal is wrapped in thanks, hedges and excuses.
speaker_intent: To decline while preserving face and the relationship.
rate: slow at the start, a little faster on the excuse
pauses: pause before the 'no' part; trailing ending
emphasis: on thanks and the excuse; the actual refusal is softened and quick
thai_note: Thai refusals rarely say ไม่ flatly. Use ไม่เป็นไร(ค่ะ/ครับ), ขอบคุณนะคะ แต่..., คงจะ... ไม่สะดวก, ไว้คราวหน้านะคะ, เกรงใจจัง. Soft particles and a small laugh. ไม่เป็นไร here means 'no thanks'. Keep tones exact; only level, rate and voice soften. BrownLevinson1987 face-saving.
examples_th: โอ้ย เกรงใจจังเลยค่ะ ไม่เป็นไรค่ะ วันนี้คงยังไม่ซื้อ ไว้คราวหน้านะคะ
ขอบคุณมากเลยครับลุง แต่ผมคงจะไม่สะดวกไปจริงๆ ครับ ไว้โอกาสหน้านะครับ
examples_en: Oh, thank you so much, but I don't think I can make it this time. Maybe next time?
ai_mistakes: Reads ไม่เป็นไร as consolation instead of a soft decline.
gemini_style: politely declining in a Thai way, soft, apologetic and smiling, not wanting to hurt feelings
evidence_note: Face/politeness framework; no acoustic data. Cultural/craft notes.

name_th: ร่าเริงฝืนๆ
meaning: Acting upbeat while sad, tired or upset; the cheerfulness is a mask.
speaker_intent: To hide distress, protect others, or keep up appearances (e.g. serving a customer).
pitch_level: surface: higher than baseline; leak: drops at phrase ends
pitch_range: surface: wide but repetitive, rigid melody; leak: narrows on the last word
rate: surface: a bit too quick; leak: a slowed word or pause where feeling breaks through
energy: surface: bright and loud; leak: energy collapses at the end of phrases
pauses: a tiny unnatural pause before the cheer resumes
voice_quality: surface: smiling but tense; leak: brief thinness or tremor on one word
breath: a hidden sigh or uneven breath between bright phrases
emphasis: over-emphasis on happy words; key sad word slipped in softly
thai_note: Surface: bright particles (นะคะ / เลยค่ะ / จ้า) and wider range. Leak: last particle drops low and flat, or the voice wobbles on one content word. No lexical tone changes; just let level and steadiness falter.
examples_th: ยินดีต้อนรับค่ะ! วันนี้... วันนี้ร้านเรามีโปรดีๆ เลยนะคะ
ไม่เป็นไรครับ ผมโอเคมาก! ...โอเคจริงๆ
examples_en: I'm fine! Totally fine. Really.
variants: Smile cracks with tremor on one word.
Steady cheer, only a sigh after.
ai_mistakes: Leak spread over the whole line instead of one spot.
gemini_style: forcing a bright cheerful voice while secretly sad, smile slipping at the end
evidence_note: No study of masked emotion in the listed sources; layering is craft.

name_th: โกรธแต่สุภาพ
meaning: Anger held under courteous words, common in service settings and Thai social norms.
speaker_intent: To express displeasure without losing face or breaking politeness.
pitch_level: surface: normal or slightly lower; leak: sharper level on key word
pitch_range: surface: narrow, controlled; leak: clipped falls
rate: surface: slow, too even; leak: clipped consonants
energy: surface: moderate; leak: pressure builds on the complaint
pauses: deliberate, measured pauses; a pause before the polite particle
breath: controlled breath through nose; tight exhale
emphasis: on the problem word; particles said crisply
thai_note: Thai polite anger keeps ครับ / ค่ะ / นะคะ but says them clipped and evenly; คุณ instead of nickname adds distance. Too-even pace and pressed quality leak the anger. Lexical tones unchanged.
examples_th: ขอโทษนะคะ นี่เป็นครั้งที่สามแล้วที่แว่นยังไม่เสร็จนะคะ
ผมเข้าใจครับ... แต่ผมจ่ายเงินไปแล้วครับ ตั้งแต่อาทิตย์ก่อน
examples_en: I understand. But this is the third time I've asked.
gemini_style: politely angry, calm and courteous on the surface but clearly seething underneath
evidence_note: Craft; tense voice quality as attitude carrier (GoblNiChasaide2003).

name_th: ทำเป็นกล้าทั้งที่กลัว
meaning: Acting brave or tough while scared.
speaker_intent: To convince self and others that they're not afraid.
pitch_level: surface: lowered artificially; leak: jumps up on one word
rate: surface: a bit too fast; leak: stumble
energy: surface: loud; leak: drops when the scary thing is mentioned
pauses: a too-short pause before the brave claim, a gulp after
voice_quality: surface: pushed chest voice; leak: thin or shaky on the feared object
emphasis: on brave words (ไม่กลัว); feared noun said smaller
thai_note: Use loud claims ไม่กลัวหรอก / สบายมาก with brash particles (เว้ย, หรอก), then let the voice thin on ผี or the feared word. Tones stay; the crack is in level and steadiness.
examples_th: ผีเหรอ ไม่กลัวหรอกครับ ผมอยู่ร้านคนเดียวได้สบาย... เมื่อกี้เสียงอะไรน่ะ
ไม่เห็นน่ากลัวเลย หยอดตาแค่นี้เอง... มัน มันจะแสบมั้ยคะ
examples_en: Ghosts? I'm not scared. ...What was that noise?
gemini_style: trying to sound brave and tough but clearly scared, voice cracking on the scary word
evidence_note: Craft only.

name_th: กลั้นน้ำตา
meaning: Trying not to cry while speaking; strong sadness held in.
speaker_intent: To stay composed and finish speaking.
pitch_level: surface: steady; leak: rises and wavers on the emotional word
rate: slow, careful; speeds up to get through
pauses: stops to swallow or breathe; pause before the hardest word
emphasis: hard word said quietly, voice breaking
thai_note: Let the voice tighten and break on the emotional word; particles may be dropped or come out shaky (นะ... ครับ). Swallowing pauses carry it. Tones must remain correct even with a crack.
examples_th: ไม่เป็นไรครับยาย... ผม... ผมจะดูแลร้านต่อเองครับ
แม่บอกหนูว่า... ตาแม่จะไม่กลับมาเห็นอีกแล้วค่ะ
examples_en: It's okay... I'll... I'll take care of it.
gemini_style: fighting back tears, voice tight and trembling, pausing to swallow
evidence_note: Craft; voice-quality literature supports tense/breathy cues generally.

name_th: หัวเราะทั้งน้ำตา
meaning: Simultaneous grief and joy or relief, e.g. a happy reunion or funny memory at a sad time.
speaker_intent: To express both feelings honestly.
pauses: laugh-breaks and sniffles
emphasis: on the funny or tender detail
thai_note: Mix laugh-breaths (ฮึ ฮ่า) with sniffles; particles like อ่ะ / นะ / จัง break naturally. Tones lexical; emotion is in breath and wobble.
examples_th: ยายจ๋า... ฮ่าๆ ยายยังใส่แว่นกลับด้านเหมือนเดิมเลย... คิดถึงจังเลยนะ
ผมเห็นชัดแล้วครับหมอ ฮ่าๆ เห็นหน้าลูกชัดเป็นครั้งแรกเลย
examples_en: I can see her face... I can actually see her!
gemini_style: laughing and crying at the same time, overwhelmed with emotion, wet and shaky
evidence_note: Craft only.

name_th: หัวเราะแก้เขิน แก้เก้อ
meaning: Laughing from awkwardness, embarrassment or anxiety, not amusement; common in Thai to smooth awkward moments.
speaker_intent: To defuse tension or hide discomfort.
pauses: laughter fills pauses
emphasis: the awkward word followed by a laugh
thai_note: Thai uses แหะๆ / ฮ่าๆ / เอ่อ... with a laugh to smooth awkwardness (แก้เก้อ). Particles ครับ / ค่ะ follow. Tones intact.
examples_th: แหะๆ ขอโทษครับ ผมนั่งทับแว่นลูกค้าไปแล้ว...
ฮ่าๆ หนูลืมเอาใบสั่งมาค่ะ ขอโทษนะคะ
examples_en: Heh... sorry, I think I sat on your glasses.
gemini_style: laughing nervously from embarrassment, a short awkward chuckle
evidence_note: Craft only.

name_th: จากกลัวเป็นโล่งใจ
meaning: Start: fear or dread. Trigger: discovering the threat is not real or is over. End: relief.
speaker_intent: To voice the moment of realization that things are okay.
pitch_level: start high and tight; after trigger drops below baseline
pitch_range: start narrow and tense; end wider, relaxed fall
rate: start fast; after trigger slows sharply
energy: start tense; collapses into release at the trigger word
pauses: a held pause at the trigger, then a relieved exhale
voice_quality: start tense/thin; end breathy and lax
breath: held breath before trigger, big exhale after
emphasis: trigger word (อ๋อ, แมว, เอง) carries the turn
thai_note: The turn is often marked by อ๋อ / โธ่ / เฮ้อ / นึกว่า... Pitch level drops and rate slows on the relief clause; particles become soft (เอง, นะ). Tones intact throughout; only level, range and rate shift.
examples_th: ใครน่ะ! ใคร... อ๋อ ยายเองเหรอ เฮ้อ นึกว่าขโมย
ผลตรวจ... ผลตรวจเป็นยังไงบ้างคะ... ไม่เป็นต้อเหรอคะ โล่งไปเลย
examples_en: Who's there?! ...Oh. It's just the cat. Phew.
gemini_style: starting frightened and tense, then suddenly relieved with a big exhale
evidence_note: Fear/relief endpoints use arousal tendencies; transitions are craft.

name_th: จากโกรธเป็นเศร้า
meaning: Start: hot anger or blame. Trigger: the speaker hears their own words or realizes the hurt underneath. End: sadness, the anger draining out.
speaker_intent: To vent, then let the real pain show.
pitch_level: start high and loud; after the turn drops low
pitch_range: start wide with sharp falls; end narrow
rate: start fast and clipped; slows sharply after the turning word
pauses: a sudden pause at the turn (often after a shouted phrase), then quiet continuation
voice_quality: start tense/pressed; end breathy, possibly cracking
breath: heavy breathing in the anger part, a shaky breath at the turn
emphasis: anger part stresses blame words; sad part stresses the loss word softly
thai_note: Typically the turn comes after a repeated word or ทำไม; anger particles (วะ, ดิ, หรอก) give way to softer or dropped particles. Lexical tones stay intact through the shift; level, rate and voice quality carry it. Place the turn where the text pivots (often after '...').
examples_th: ทำไมลุงไม่ไปหาหมอตั้งแต่แรก! ทำไม... ทำไมไม่บอกผมสักคำ...
หนูโกรธยายนะ! ที่หายไปไม่บอกกัน... หนูแค่... คิดถึงยายค่ะ
examples_en: Why didn't you tell me?! Why... why didn't you just tell me...
gemini_style: starting angry and loud, then breaking down into quiet sadness halfway through
evidence_note: Endpoint tendencies (hot anger vs sadness) are supported in acted speech; the transition itself is craft.

name_th: จากไม่ยอมรับเป็นยอมรับ
meaning: Start: refusing a fact. Trigger: the evidence sinks in (a test result, a memory, a word from someone). End: quiet acceptance.
speaker_intent: To reject, then let go.
pitch_range: start moderate-wide; end narrow and settled
pauses: a long pause at the realization; the acceptance phrase starts after a breath
breath: a deep exhale marks the acceptance
emphasis: denial words ไม่ / ไม่ใช่ / เป็นไปไม่ได้ stressed early; acceptance phrase unstressed
thai_note: Denial with ไม่ใช่ / ไม่จริง / เป็นไปไม่ได้, often repeated, then a breath and ...ใช่สินะ / ก็คงจะจริง with soft particles (สินะ, แหละ). The tone of ไม่ stays lexical; insistence comes from loudness and rate.
examples_th: ไม่จริงครับ ตาผมยังดีอยู่ เป็นไปไม่ได้... ...ก็จริงแหละ ผมมองป้ายไม่ชัดมาตั้งนานแล้ว
ยายยังไม่ไปไหนหรอก... ยายแค่... ใช่สินะ ยายไม่อยู่แล้วจริงๆ
examples_en: No, that's not right. That can't be... ...It's true, isn't it.
variants: Acceptance with a small bitter laugh.
gemini_style: first refusing to believe it, then quietly accepting the truth with a deep sigh
evidence_note: Craft only.

name_th: จากนิ่งเป็นตื่นตระหนก
meaning: Start: normal calm. Trigger: sudden danger or alarming discovery. End: panic.
speaker_intent: To react as the threat registers.
pitch_level: start baseline; after trigger jumps high
rate: start normal; end very fast, broken
pauses: a frozen pause at the trigger, then no pauses
voice_quality: start relaxed; end tense, shrill, breathy
breath: sharp gasp at the trigger, fast breathing after
emphasis: the discovery word, then everything urgent
thai_note: Calm particles (ครับ, นะ) at first; after the gasp, short exclamations เฮ้ย / ตายแล้ว / ช่วยด้วย, particles dropped. Overall pitch and rate rise; lexical tones remain correct even when shrill.
examples_th: วันนี้ปิดร้านเร็วหน่อยนะครับ เดี๋ยวผมนับเงิน... เฮ้ย! เงินหายไปไหนหมด! ใครเอาไป!
คุณยายคะ ยายอยู่ไหนคะ... ยาย? ยาย! ช่วยด้วยค่ะ ยายล้ม!
examples_en: Just closing up... wait. Where's the money? Where is it?!
gemini_style: calm and casual at first, then suddenly panicking, gasping and fast
evidence_note: Panic fear tendencies (high F0, fast) supported in acted speech; transition is craft.

name_th: รักแต่โกรธ
meaning: Anger at someone you love, with tenderness breaking through the anger or anger cutting through tenderness.
speaker_intent: To scold or confront while protecting the bond.
pitch_range: wide, alternating sharp and soft contours
rate: fast in the scolding, slower on the tender words
pauses: a pause before the softening clause
emphasis: blame words sharp, the loving words (ห่วง, รัก) gentle
thai_note: Common Thai pattern: scolding then ก็ห่วงไง / เพราะรักนะ with softer particles (นะ, ไง, จ้ะ). Shift level and quality, never tones.
examples_th: ทำไมไม่ใส่แว่นขับรถ! ถ้าเป็นอะไรไปจะทำยังไง... แม่ห่วงนะลูก
ยายโกรธหลานนะ ที่อดนอนจนตาแดงแบบนี้... กินข้าวหรือยังจ๊ะ
examples_en: You could've been killed! Don't you ever... I love you, okay?
gemini_style: a worried mother angrily scolding her child, but love breaking through at the end
evidence_note: Craft only.

name_th: ทิฐิปิดความเจ็บ
meaning: Wounded feelings fighting the need to keep face; refusing to show hurt.
speaker_intent: To appear unaffected and dignified.
pitch_level: steady or slightly lower; brief rise on the painful word
pauses: a micro-pause before the hurtful topic
voice_quality: firm with a thin edge on one word
emphasis: on dignity words (ไม่ต้อง, ไม่เป็นไร, เองได้)
thai_note: Thai pride: ไม่ต้อง / ไม่เป็นไร / ทำเองได้ with firm particles (ครับ, หรอก). One unsteady word leaks hurt. Tones lexical.
examples_th: ไม่ต้องมาสงสารลุงหรอก ลุงอยู่ได้ ร้านไม่มีใครมาก็ไม่เป็นไร
ไม่เป็นไรค่ะ ถ้าเขาไม่อยากได้แว่นที่หนูเลือก หนูก็... ไม่ได้เสียใจอะไร
examples_en: I don't need your pity. I'm fine on my own.
variants: Quiet firm refusal with one break.
gemini_style: proud and stubborn, hiding hurt behind a firm voice that slips on one word
evidence_note: Craft only.

name_th: ลาก่อนทั้งยิ้มทั้งเศร้า
meaning: Saying goodbye with gratitude and love mixed with sadness.
speaker_intent: To part warmly and honor the relationship.
pauses: lingering pauses, esp. before 'goodbye'
voice_quality: warm breathy, smile with slight wobble
emphasis: on gratitude words and farewell
thai_note: Warm particles (นะ, จ้ะ, เนอะ) and lengthened ending of ลาก่อน / ไปแล้วนะ. A smile and a wobble together. Tones unchanged.
examples_th: ขอบใจนะหลานที่ดูแลร้านนี้ต่อ... ยายไปก่อนนะจ๊ะ อย่าลืมใส่แว่นล่ะ
พรุ่งนี้หนูย้ายไปเชียงใหม่แล้วค่ะ ขอบคุณที่ตัดแว่นให้หนูมาตั้งแต่ ป.1 นะคะ
examples_en: Thank you for everything. I'll miss this place.
gemini_style: a warm bittersweet goodbye, smiling but a little teary, slow and grateful
evidence_note: Craft only.

name_th: สะใจ
meaning: Pleasure at someone else's misfortune, usually someone seen as deserving it (a cheating rival shop, a rude customer). Often kept half-hidden because it is socially frowned upon.
speaker_intent: To savor the moment and share the satisfaction with an ally, while half pretending not to.
pitch_level: slightly higher than baseline, dipping low on the 'serves them right' phrase
pitch_range: moderate, sly rise-falls; one exaggerated rise on the misfortune detail
rate: moderate, slowing to savor the key detail
energy: medium, held back as if not to be overheard
pauses: a small pause before the verdict word (สมน้ำหน้า), sometimes filled by a snort-laugh
voice_quality: smiling voice with a nasal edge; a chuckle squeezed through closed lips
breath: short nasal snort or 'ฮึๆ' held laugh after the line
emphasis: on what happened to them, lengthened and relished
thai_note: Thai สะใจ is often voiced with สมน้ำหน้า / สมควรแล้ว / ดีแล้วล่ะ and a held laugh; particles ล่ะ / ไง / เลย stretched a little. The glee lives in the smiling voice quality, a lower dip on the verdict and lengthening, never in altering the lexical tone of สม or น้ำ. With a polite ครับ/ค่ะ it becomes a sly 'I shouldn't say this' version.
examples_th: ร้านที่ขายแว่นปลอมให้ลุงโดนสั่งปิดแล้วเหรอครับ... สมน้ำหน้า ฮึๆ
ดีแล้วล่ะ ไม่ยอมใส่แว่น ขับรถถอยไปชนกระถางตัวเองเลย ฮ่าๆ
examples_en: They got shut down? Well... serves them right.
variants: Sly chuckle: quiet, nasal, eyes-to-the-side delivery.
Open glee among friends: louder laugh, wider range.
Guilty pleasure: starts gleeful, then a half-hearted 'แย่จัง'.
Deadpan satisfaction: flat 'ดีแล้ว' with a tiny smile at the end.
ai_mistakes: Plays innocent joy as if good news for the speaker.
Turns it into cruel villain laughter.
Leaves out the suppressed laugh entirely.
Reads สมน้ำหน้า with sympathetic softness.
gemini_style: quietly pleased at a rival's bad luck, sly and satisfied, holding back a snicker
evidence_note: Not a category in the listed acted-speech corpora; PAD placement is rough. All delivery notes are craft.

name_th: ได้ใจ คุยโว
meaning: Openly showing off one's win in front of the loser; unlike schadenfreude the focus is on one's own triumph and it is aimed at the other person.
speaker_intent: To rub the victory in and claim status.
pitch_level: higher than baseline, swooping down on 'I told you'
rate: slow and drawn out, savoring each word of the win
pauses: triumphant pause before the punchline, as if waiting for applause
voice_quality: bright, smug, slightly nasal; self-satisfied laugh
breath: a pleased 'ฮึ' or laugh, audible satisfied exhale
emphasis: on 'I' (ผม/ฉัน), 'told you' (บอกแล้ว) and the result
thai_note: Thai gloating uses เห็นมั้ยล่ะ / บอกแล้วไง / ว่าแล้ว with drawn-out particles (ไง~ / ล่ะ~ / เลย~). The smugness is a wide, slow, sing-song overall contour and nasal brightness; each syllable keeps its lexical tone, especially numbers (สองร้อยห้าสิบ) which must stay intelligible.
examples_th: เห็นมั้ยล่ะลุง บอกแล้วไงว่าค่าสายตาลุงต้องสองร้อยห้าสิบ เป๊ะเลย!
ว่าแล้วไงคะ ลูกค้ากลับมาตัดแว่นร้านเราหมดเลย ร้านฝั่งโน้นเงียบกริบ
examples_en: Told you so. Two-fifty, exactly. Who's the expert now?
variants: Loud victory dance: high energy, laughing.
Quiet superiority: low, calm, looking down.
Friendly gloat between buddies: teasing, no malice.
ai_mistakes: Simply happy, no aim at the loser.
Fast cheerful delivery with no savoring.
gemini_style: smugly gloating over a win, slow and drawn-out, rubbing it in with a satisfied laugh
evidence_note: High-dominance positive placement from PAD; no acoustic study of gloating. Craft.

name_th: ตื่นตาตื่นใจแบบเด็ก
meaning: Open, delighted amazement at something seen anew, like a child (or an adult) putting on correct glasses for the first time and seeing leaves, stars or a loved face clearly.
speaker_intent: To voice discovery and invite others to look too.
rate: slow, stretched on the discovery, then quicker excited bursts
pauses: a breathless pause (gasp) before the first word; pauses while 'looking'
emphasis: on the wow words and the thing seen (ใบไม้, ดาว, หน้าแม่)
thai_note: Use โห / ว้าว / อู้หู lengthened, and particles เลย / อ่ะ / จัง / ด้วย. Lengthening and breathiness carry wonder; keep the lexical tones of content words (ใบไม้, ชัด) correct, only raising overall level and widening the range.
examples_th: โห... ใบไม้มันมีเส้นด้วยเหรอครับ ผมไม่เคยเห็นชัดขนาดนี้เลย
แม่ดูสิคะ ดาวเต็มฟ้าเลย! เมื่อก่อนหนูเห็นเป็นแค่จุดเบลอๆ
examples_en: Whoa... trees have separate leaves? Nobody told me!
variants: Elder's rediscovery: slow, warm, a little teary.
gemini_style: a child seeing the world clearly for the first time, breathless with wonder and delight
evidence_note: Awe appears among vocal-burst categories (Cowen2019) but speech prosody of wonder is not directly measured; craft.

name_th: แสบ ซน
meaning: Playful naughtiness; planning or enjoying a harmless prank.
speaker_intent: To have fun and recruit a partner-in-crime.
pitch_level: slightly higher, dipping low for the secret part
rate: quick bursts with held suspense beats
energy: medium, kept down so the target won't hear
pauses: suspense pause before revealing the plan
emphasis: on the prank detail and the target
thai_note: Thai mischief uses particles ป่ะ / นะ / เนอะ / ล่ะ and stifled ฮิๆ / คิกๆ. Fun comes from giggly quality and playful range, not from changing the lexical tone of any word.
examples_th: ยายจะแอบเอาแว่นลุงชาญไปซ่อนในตู้นะ ฮิๆ อย่าบอกลุงล่ะ
เต๋า เอาแว่นจมูกปลอมอันนี้ไปใส่แกล้งมิ้นท์กันป่ะ คิกๆ
examples_en: Let's hide his glasses in the fridge. Hehe. He'll never look there.
gemini_style: mischievous and giggly, quietly plotting a harmless prank
evidence_note: Craft only.

name_th: ง่วงงุน
meaning: Sleepy, barely alert; e.g. Ton at the counter at 2 a.m., a child at bedtime.
speaker_intent: To respond with minimal effort while half asleep.
pauses: long pauses, yawns mid-phrase
emphasis: almost none
thai_note: Articulation softens (ครับ may come out as a light คับ, final consonants weak) and particles trail off. Even when slurred, each syllable's lexical tone should stay recognizable; drowsiness lowers level, narrows range and slows rate.
examples_th: ตีสองแล้วเหรอครับ... ฮ้าว... ยังมีลูกค้ามาอีกเหรอ
แม่คะ... หนูง่วงแล้ว... พรุ่งนี้ค่อยลองแว่นนะคะ
examples_en: Is it two a.m. already...? Mm... just five more minutes.
gemini_style: very drowsy and half asleep, slow mumbling with a yawn
evidence_note: Low-arousal tendencies (slow, soft, low F0) generalize; sleepiness itself is not in the acted-emotion sets. Craft.

name_th: กระซิบซุบซิบ
meaning: Sharing a secret or gossip and drawing the listener in close.
speaker_intent: To make the listener an insider.
pitch_range: narrow, but expressive within the whisper
rate: quick and hushed, slowing for the secret itself
pauses: a 'check nobody's listening' pause before the secret
emphasis: the secret word whispered slower and more clearly
thai_note: Thai gossip openers นี่ๆ / รู้ยัง / อย่าบอกใครนะ, particles นะ / เนอะ / อ่ะ. Full whisper removes voicing, so lexical tones become hard to hear; prefer a breathy half-voice so tones stay intelligible, and never change tones to sound secretive.
examples_th: นี่ๆ รู้ยัง ลุงชาญแอบใส่คอนแทคเลนส์สีฟ้านะ อย่าบอกใครล่ะ
ต้น... ยายจะบอกความลับนะ ในตู้หลังร้านมีแว่นของตาเก็บไว้อยู่จ้ะ
examples_en: Psst. Don't tell anyone, but Uncle Chan wears blue contacts.
ai_mistakes: Lost Thai tones from full whisper.
gemini_style: whispering a juicy secret, close and hushed, a little excited
evidence_note: Breathy/whisper as attitude carrier fits voice-quality work generally; specifics are craft.

name_th: นิ่งจนขนลุก
meaning: Unnaturally calm narration or dialogue in an unsettling scene (horror or ghost-story register): the mismatch between calm voice and strange content creates chills.
speaker_intent: To unsettle the listener through stillness rather than shock.
pitch_range: very narrow; phrases end level instead of falling
pauses: long, slightly irregular pauses in unexpected places
voice_quality: soft, smooth, a little breathy; no tension
emphasis: almost none; the scariest word is said just as flatly
thai_note: For ghost narration (ร้านแว่นตีสอง) use slow even rate, flat level phrase ends, and gentle particles (นะ, จ้ะ) said without warmth. Eeriness is the flat level contour and timing; lexical tones of every word stay correct (a flat contour does not mean flattening the tones themselves).
examples_th: ตีสองตรง... ประตูร้านแว่นจะเปิดเองนะ... ทุกคืน
หลานเห็นยายไหมจ๊ะ... ยายยืนอยู่ข้างหลังหลานมานานแล้วนะ
examples_en: At exactly two a.m., the shop door opens. By itself. Every night.
variants: Dreamy, distant, as if from another room.
ai_mistakes: Wide pitch movement that breaks the stillness.
gemini_style: eerily calm and flat, slow and even, an unsettling stillness
evidence_note: Craft only; horror-narration conventions.

name_th: เล่านิทานอบอุ่น
meaning: A narration register that draws listeners into a story with warmth and gentle drama, like a grandparent at bedtime.
speaker_intent: To engage, guide and comfort an audience through the story.
pitch_range: moderate-wide; character voices and suspense contours
rate: moderate and varied: slower at suspense, quicker in action
pauses: suspense pause before turning points; a beat after questions to the listener
breath: natural, occasionally an audible 'and then...' breath
emphasis: on story turns and sensory words
thai_note: Thai storytelling openers: กาลครั้งหนึ่ง / มีอยู่คืนหนึ่ง / แล้วรู้ไหม, particles นะ / จ้ะ / ล่ะ. Liveliness comes from range, pace and pauses; lexical tones of each word stay correct, especially in names (ต้น, จันทร์, ชาญ).
examples_th: มีอยู่คืนหนึ่งนะ ร้านแว่นเล็กๆ ปลายซอย ยังเปิดไฟอยู่ดวงเดียว
แล้วรู้ไหมจ๊ะ ว่าใครเดินเข้ามาในร้านตอนตีสอง...
examples_en: One night, at the end of a quiet lane, one little shop still had its light on.
gemini_style: a warm storyteller drawing listeners in, gentle and expressive, with suspense pauses
evidence_note: Craft only.

name_th: ขายของกระตือรือร้น
meaning: Upbeat commercial voice for promotions and offers.
speaker_intent: To excite the audience and push them to act (visit, buy, message).
rate: brisk, but price and offer said clearly
pauses: a beat before the offer or price, a beat after the call to action
emphasis: on product name, price, discount and deadline
thai_note: Promo Thai uses วันนี้เท่านั้น / ลดพิเศษ / รีบเลย / ทักมาเลย and particles นะคะ / เลยครับ / จ้า. Numbers and prices must keep their exact lexical tones (สาม vs. สาม-ร้อย) so they are not misheard; excitement is in level, range and energy.
examples_th: แว่นกรองแสงสีฟ้า ลดพิเศษวันนี้เท่านั้นนะคะ ทักมาเลยค่ะ!
ตรวจสายตาฟรี พร้อมกรอบแว่นสวยๆ ให้เลือกเพียบเลยครับ แวะมาได้ทุกวัน
examples_en: Free eye test with every frame, this week only!
ai_mistakes: Stress on the wrong word, burying the price.
gemini_style: an upbeat, friendly shop promo voice, bright and energetic, clear on the price
evidence_note: Craft only.

name_th: ผู้เชี่ยวชาญน่าเชื่อถือ
meaning: Calm authoritative explaining voice for eye-health facts and product advice.
speaker_intent: To inform clearly and earn the listener's trust.
pitch_range: moderate, confident falls at phrase ends
pauses: after key facts and numbers so they sink in
emphasis: on facts, numbers and the recommended action
thai_note: Clear articulation, polite ครับ / ค่ะ, calm falling phrases; avoid rising question tails that sound unsure. Medical words (ต้อเนื้อ, ค่าสายตา) must keep their lexical tones exactly; authority comes from steady level and rate.
examples_th: ค่าสายตาเปลี่ยนได้ทุกปีครับ ควรตรวจอย่างน้อยปีละครั้ง
แสงแดดเป็นสาเหตุหนึ่งของต้อเนื้อค่ะ แว่นกันแดดที่กัน UV ช่วยได้มาก
examples_en: Your prescription can change every year, so get checked at least once a year.
gemini_style: a calm, trusted optometrist explaining clearly and confidently
evidence_note: Craft only.

name_th: แสดงความเสียใจอย่างเป็นทางการ
meaning: Respectful formal sympathy for a death or loss, e.g. a shop notice or a public statement.
speaker_intent: To honor the deceased and respect the family with dignity.
pauses: measured pauses between clauses; pause before the name
voice_quality: soft but clear, controlled; no tears
emphasis: gentle weight on the name and the condolence phrase
thai_note: Formal Thai: ขอแสดงความเสียใจ / ขอไว้อาลัย / ขอให้ดวงวิญญาณไปสู่สุคติ, with polite ครับ / ค่ะ. Formality comes from slow rate, lower level and restrained voice; lexical tones stay exact (especially in names and royal-style formal words).
examples_th: ทางร้านขอแสดงความเสียใจกับครอบครัวของคุณยายจันทร์ด้วยครับ
ขอให้ดวงวิญญาณของคุณตาไปสู่สุคตินะคะ
examples_en: We extend our deepest condolences to the family.
gemini_style: a respectful formal condolence, slow, soft and dignified
evidence_note: Craft only.

name_th: เฉยเมย ไม่แคร์
meaning: Not caring about the topic or the person; disengaged, sometimes as a deliberate snub.
speaker_intent: To signal lack of interest or end the conversation.
rate: slow drawl or short clipped answers
pauses: few; or a dismissive gap before answering
emphasis: none
thai_note: Thai: ก็แล้วแต่ / ไม่รู้สิ / เออ / อะไรก็ได้ with flat, dropped or minimal particles. Indifference comes from low level, narrow range and lack of energy; lexical tones of words remain intact.
examples_th: เออ... แล้วแต่เลย จะกรอบไหนก็ได้
ไม่รู้สิคะ ไม่ได้สนใจเรื่องแว่นเท่าไหร่
examples_en: Whatever. Any frame's fine.
gemini_style: bored and indifferent, flat and low, not caring at all
evidence_note: Boredom tendencies (low F0, narrow range, slow) in acted speech are an analogy; indifference itself is craft.
